# Prime Marble Specialists
> London specialists in marble and natural-stone installation and finishing, coordinating specialist fabrication through trusted workshop partners.

Website: https://primemarbletiling.co.uk/
Primary service area: London, United Kingdom
Phone: +44 7979 515900

## Fabrication model
Prime Marble Specialists can coordinate fabrication through trusted specialist workshop partners and provide finishing and installation. Customers may enquire about projects using stone they have already purchased or sourced elsewhere; purchasing stone through Prime Marble Specialists is not a requirement. The exact scope is assessed project by project.

## Core services
- Marble and natural-stone fabrication
- Stone cutting, finishing and polishing
- Marble and natural-stone installation
- Customer-supplied stone fabrication and fitting
- Marble bathrooms
- Stone staircases and flooring
- Feature walls
- Worktops, islands and vanity tops
- Large-format porcelain installation
